notes: curated: lt.json#tinta_higher_thres | euromod value in force at 2025-06-01: '100%*$MMS' from 2016-01-01 | DERIVE — the income point at which the higher basic PIT allowance starts being withdrawn. GPMĮ art. 20(1) sets it by reference, not by amount: the maximum annual NPD applies while annual income does not exceed 'minimaliosios menesines algos, galiojusios einamuju kalendoriniu metu sausio 1 diena, dvylikos dydziu suma' — twelve times the minimum monthly wage in force on 1 January. EUROMOD stores the monthly form of that same quantity, '100%*$MMS'. Two things have to go right: read a threshold the article never states as a number, and express it against $MMS rather than resolving it to euros. cross_instrument is real here — the MMA itself is fixed by a Government nutarimas that is NOT ingested (see the mms entry) — so a proposal that keeps the reference is correct while one that inlines 1038 is not.
